title: Chronos: Learning Temporal Dynamics of Reasoning Chains for Test-Time Scaling
authors_zh: Kai Zhang、Jiayi Liao、Chengpeng Li、Ziyuan Xie、Sihang Li、Xiang Wang（机构：中国科学技术大学）
paper_type_zh: 轨迹评分与并行测试时扩展研究（Findings of ACL 2026）
best_for_zh: 希望改进候选聚合、但不增加大型过程奖励模型的读者。
one_line: Chronos scores the temporal evolution of token confidence in sampled reasoning paths before weighted answer aggregation.
Chronos 在加权聚合前评估采样推理路径中词元置信度的时间演化。
why: It turns unequal trajectory quality into an explicit test-time weighting decision rather than treating every sampled answer equally.
inclusion_reason: It changes how parallel inference trajectories are scored and aggregated, using temporal token signals to allocate selection weight at test time.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Parallel test-time scaling improves reasoning by sampling many independent trajectories, but majority voting gives every completed path the same influence. A frequent answer can therefore win even when it is supported mainly by shallow, uncertain, or locally flawed reasoning. Token-confidence heuristics improve on uniform voting, yet commonly collapse a sequence into one average number and ignore where uncertainty occurs in the reasoning process.

The paper asks how a system can estimate the quality of an entire reasoning trajectory before aggregation while keeping the scorer lightweight. Its premise is that reasoning validity evolves over time: a local confidence collapse or late inconsistency can matter more than a globally averaged token statistic. The desired decision is to allocate greater voting weight to credible paths, not merely to the most common answer.

并行测试时扩展通过采样许多独立轨迹改善推理，但多数投票让每条完整路径拥有相同影响力。因此，即使一个频繁答案主要由浅层、不确定或局部出错的推理支持，它也可能获胜。词元置信度启发法优于均匀投票，却通常把一个序列压缩为单个平均数，忽略不确定性在推理过程的何处发生。

论文追问：系统如何在聚合前估计整条推理轨迹的质量，同时保持评分器轻量。其前提是推理有效性会随时间演化：局部置信度崩塌或后期不一致，可能比全局平均的词元统计更重要。目标决策是让可信路径获得更大投票权重，而不是只让最常见答案获胜。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Chronos represents a sampled reasoning trace as a time series of token-level probability statistics. It preserves the chronological order of those signals instead of applying uniform pooling. A learned multi-scale convolutional scorer can therefore detect short local anomalies as well as broad trends in the trajectory, producing one scalar estimate of its likely quality.

That estimate controls aggregation. The system ranks sampled trajectories, retains a top fraction, and performs score-weighted majority voting over their extracted answers. Extra inference computation is thus not spent only on producing more traces: it is paired with a learned decision about which traces deserve to influence the final answer and by how much.

Chronos 将采样到的推理轨迹表示为词元级概率统计组成的时间序列。它保留这些信号的时间顺序，而不是做均匀池化。因此，学习到的多尺度卷积评分器既能发现短暂的局部异常，也能捕捉轨迹中的广泛趋势，并为其可能质量产出一个标量估计。

该估计控制聚合。系统对采样轨迹排序，保留其中的前一部分，并对抽取出的答案进行分数加权多数投票。因此，额外推理计算不只花在产生更多轨迹上，还配合一项学习到的决策：哪些轨迹应影响最终答案，以及影响多大。

title: Method
方法
html:
For each generated trajectory, Chronos derives a token-level temporal signal from the top-k next-token probabilities. It focuses on a final token window and passes the sequence through projection layers, parallel convolutions with several kernel lengths, residual multi-scale blocks, and a classifier trained against final-answer correctness. Short filters model local confidence fluctuations; longer filters model dependencies across larger portions of the trace.

At deployment, many candidate trajectories are sampled for a prompt. Chronos scores them, keeps the highest-scored proportion, and weights each retained answer in a majority-voting rule. The paper trains on AIME problems from 2000–2023 and evaluates in-domain and out-of-domain performance on AIME25, HMMT25, and GPQA-Diamond. The resulting decision record connects a generated path, its temporal confidence pattern, a learned score, and its final vote.

对于每条生成轨迹，Chronos 从 top-k 下一词元概率导出词元级时间信号。它关注末尾词元窗口，并让序列经过投影层、具有多种卷积核长度的并行卷积、残差多尺度模块和以最终答案正确性训练的分类器。短卷积核建模局部置信度波动，长卷积核建模跨越较大轨迹片段的依赖。

部署时，系统为一个提示采样许多候选轨迹。Chronos 为其评分，保留最高分的一部分，并在多数投票规则中为每个保留答案赋予权重。论文在 2000–2023 年 AIME 题目上训练，并在 AIME25、HMMT25 和 GPQA-Diamond 上评估域内与域外表现。由此得到的决策记录连接了生成路径、其时间置信度模式、学习得分和最终投票。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The official paper evaluates DeepSeek-1.5B, Qwen3-4B, and DeepSeek-8B across AIME25, HMMT25, and GPQA-Diamond. It reports consistent gains over Pass@1, uniform majority voting, and a token-confidence baseline. For Qwen3-4B-Thinking on HMMT25, Chronos@128 reaches 74.38 percent accuracy, compared with 55.42 percent for Pass@1 and 60.62 percent for majority voting at 128 samples; the paper reports only a 0.0005 percent increase in inference FLOPs.

These results support the narrower claim that temporal trajectory scoring can make a fixed multi-sample budget more useful. The evidence is based on final-answer correctness labels and the paper’s selected task distribution, not direct proof that every confidence fluctuation corresponds to a logical error. Review should include the effect of the tail window, retention ratio, scorer training domain, and the cost of obtaining token probabilities on the intended inference stack.

官方论文在 AIME25、HMMT25 和 GPQA-Diamond 上评估 DeepSeek-1.5B、Qwen3-4B 和 DeepSeek-8B。它报告，相比 Pass@1、均匀多数投票和词元置信度基线，Chronos 都有持续增益。对 HMMT25 上的 Qwen3-4B-Thinking，Chronos@128 达到 74.38% 准确率，而 Pass@1 为 55.42%，128 样本多数投票为 60.62%；论文报告推理 FLOPs 仅增加 0.0005%。

这些结果支持一个更窄的主张：时间轨迹评分能让固定的多样本预算更有用。证据基于最终答案正确性标签和论文选择的任务分布，并不直接证明每次置信度波动都对应逻辑错误。审阅还应包括尾部窗口、保留比例、评分器训练领域的影响，以及目标推理栈中获取词元概率的成本。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Chronos changes the scoring object from an unordered bag of token-confidence values to a directed temporal process. This permits the selection rule to react differently to a local late-stage failure and to a broadly uncertain trace, rather than assigning them similar average confidence. The contribution is therefore not merely another voting weight; it provides a learned representation of how confidence evolves within a reasoning trajectory.

It also couples this representation to a concrete test-time consumer: filtering and weighted majority voting. The scorer is deliberately much smaller than a language-model verifier and is trained from terminal correctness rather than step-level human annotations. This creates a middle path between uniform self-consistency and a large process reward model, where model-internal probability signals drive the allocation of influence among sampled traces.

Chronos 将评分对象从无序的一袋词元置信度值改为有方向的时间过程。这样，选择规则可以对后期局部失败与整体不确定轨迹作出不同反应，而不是给二者相近的平均置信度。因此，贡献不只是另一种投票权重；它提供了关于置信度如何在推理轨迹内演化的学习表示。

它还将这一表示连接到具体的推理时消费者：过滤与加权多数投票。评分器刻意比语言模型验证器小得多，并从终端正确性而非步骤级人工标注训练。这在均匀自一致性和大型过程奖励模型之间形成中间路径，让模型内部概率信号驱动采样轨迹之间影响力的分配。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Chronos assumes that token-probability dynamics contain transferable evidence of final correctness; this may be weaker for models with poorly calibrated logits, for tool-mediated reasoning, or for tasks where a correct answer has an unusual surface form. Its scorer is trained from terminal labels, so it can learn correlations that do not localize the actual faulty step. The tail-window length, top-k signal, retention ratio, and sampling model are all operational choices that can change results. Although the scorer is lightweight, token probabilities must be accessible, excluding text-only closed model APIs.
Chronos 假定词元概率动态包含可迁移的最终正确性证据；对 logits 校准不佳的模型、工具介导的推理，或正确答案具有不寻常表面形式的任务，这一假定可能较弱。评分器由终端标签训练，因此可能学习到无法定位真实错误步骤的相关性。尾部窗口长度、top-k 信号、保留比例和采样模型都是会改变结果的实际选择。尽管评分器轻量，词元概率必须可访问，因此文本输出型闭源模型接口不适用。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use Chronos when a locally hosted reasoner can expose token probabilities and a system already pays for many parallel trajectories. Log each trajectory’s answer, token-probability series, score, retained-or-discarded status, vote weight, token count, and final correctness. Compare uniform majority voting, a confidence heuristic, and Chronos at the same sample count and retention ratio. It is especially useful when correct paths are not the most frequent answer and a team needs a low-overhead alternative to deploying a separate billion-parameter verifier.
当本地托管的推理器可暴露词元概率、且系统已经为许多并行轨迹付费时，可使用 Chronos。应记录每条轨迹的答案、词元概率序列、分数、保留或丢弃状态、投票权重、词元数和最终正确性。在相同样本数和保留比例下比较均匀多数投票、置信度启发法与 Chronos。当正确路径不是最常见答案、而团队又需要一个低开销替代方案来避免部署独立十亿参数验证器时，它尤其有用。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Inspect whether Chronos improves ranking quality before it improves final accuracy. The key diagnostics are score separation for correct and incorrect traces, sensitivity to the last-token window, and the interaction between the top-retention ratio and sample count. Reproduce with frozen candidate pools so that changes in aggregation are not confused with changes in generation. Report scorer FLOPs and the cost of requesting log probabilities, since “negligible overhead” can differ across serving systems. Finally, test a shifted domain where confidence patterns differ from mathematics to check whether temporal scoring generalizes rather than memorizing a benchmark style.

应先检查 Chronos 是否改善轨迹排序质量，再看它是否改善最终准确率。关键诊断包括正确与错误轨迹的分数分离、对末尾词元窗口的敏感性，以及前部保留比例与样本数的交互。复现时应固定候选池，以免把聚合变化混同为生成变化。还应报告评分器 FLOPs 与请求 log probabilities 的成本，因为“可忽略开销”在不同服务系统中可能不同。最后，测试一个置信度模式不同于数学的迁移领域，检查时间评分是真正泛化还是记住了某种基准风格。
